data.name: Lelah
data.gender_notes: Lelah is used as a unisex name in christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The meaning of Lelah is recorded in name-lists as “God's Hidden One”. This meaning has NOT been verified against a classical lexical or onomastic source, so it is published as an unverified candidate only. The record is flagged for manual source verification.
data.spiritual_meaning: Lelah expresses “God's Hidden One”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Lelah total 20, reducing to 2. Number 2 is associated with cooperation, sensitivity and balance.

in_hebrew.name: לֵלָה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: From the Hebrew word לָלָה (lalah) meaning 'to wander'. In the Bible, this name is associated with the wife of Job (Job 1:2; 2:11).

in_greek.name: Λελά
in_greek.long_meaning: Derived from the Hebrew name לֵלָה (Lelah). In the Septuagint, the Greek translation of the Old Testament, this name is transliterated as Λελά (Lelá).

in_latin.name: Lelah
in_latin.long_meaning: Translated directly from the Greek name Λελά (Lelá).
